cols.t: 0 to 100 from public play by play, 50 = league average at his position, shrunk for small samples (see NOTES)
share of offensive snaps, last 4 games (nflverse snap counts)
targeted air yards per game, last 4
share of team targeted air yards, season
receiving yards per estimated route (team dropbacks x snap share), season
consensus yards line this week (receiving, RBs rushing)
games over his line that week, season
games at 1.5x his line or more
games at half his line or less
AnonMav Coverage Edge, estimated: half his own efficiency, half the estimated coverage matchup (WR/TE)
estimated: share of his routes vs each defender from alignment and side shares, not tracked coverage
his past games vs this defense, 2025 and 2026: games, targets, yards, TDs
yards per game the opponent allows to his position vs league (receiving for WR/TE, rushing for RBs)
implied team total from consensus spread and total
kickoff forecast, Open-Meteo; Dome when indoors

method: Win chance is the median of every board's no-margin chance: each sportsbook once, plus the prediction market when its game has $25k+ traded. Range is the lowest to highest board. Value means a board's price implies 3+ points less chance than the consensus. Player colors compare the matchup to league average and are context, not picks. NFL pass catcher scores are AnonMav Coverage Edge, estimated from public play by play.
